# Auto-generated by VerityQA Autonomous Investigation Agent
# Replayable Application Journey Test
import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, expect

def test_primary_discovered_progression():
    """
    Test Objective: Replay and verify the discovered application journey "Primary Discovered Progression".
    Preconditions: Application server is online and reachable.
    Evidence Grounding: Derived directly from empirical DOM observations and state transitions.
    """
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = browser.new_context()
        page = context.new_page()

        # Step 1: Navigate to entry view: http://127.0.0.1:8101/
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8101/', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        # Step 2: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8101/search [Evidence: ev-d2fc94e6]
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8101/search', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        assert '/search' in page.url, f'Expected /search in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Catalog Search' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Catalog Search'
        assert page.locator('#q').count() > 0
        # Step 3: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8101/login [Evidence: ev-26947f40]
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8101/login', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        assert '/login' in page.url, f'Expected /login in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Sign In to Apex' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Sign In to Apex'
        assert page.locator('#username').count() > 0
        # Step 4: Trigger a[href="/forgot"] [Evidence: ev-07b301f0]
        page.locator('a[href="/forgot"]').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert '/forgot' in page.url, f'Expected /forgot in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Password Reset' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Password Reset'
        assert page.locator('a[href="/"]').count() > 0
        # Step 5: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8101/registration [Evidence: ev-0678db70]
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8101/registration', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        assert '/registration' in page.url, f'Expected /registration in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Create an Apex Account' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Create an Apex Account'
        assert page.locator('#fullname').count() > 0

        # Verify final application state and DOM integrity
        assert page.url is not None and page.url.startswith('http')
        assert len(page.locator('body').inner_text().strip()) > 0
        browser.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_primary_discovered_progression()
    print('Journey replay completed successfully.')
